title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. EXECUTE Modification No. 4 to Contract No. PS93158000 with Universal Protection Service LP, dba Allied…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0753, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (6-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to:

A. EXECUTE Modification No. 4 to Contract No. PS93158000 with Universal Protection Service LP, dba Allied Universal Security Services, to continue to provide infrastructure protection services in the North Region of Los Angeles County in the amount of $2,222,438, increasing the Not-To-Exceed (NTE) total contract value from $111,266,844 to $113,489,282 to fund services through June 30, 2027; and

B. EXECUTE Modification No. 3 to Contract No. PS93158001 with Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. to continue to provide infrastructure protection services in the South Region of Los Angeles County in the amount of $11,313,262, increasing the NTE total contract value from $85,972,439 to $97,284,701 to fund services through June 30, 2027.
